newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian money market trade brisk on good supply.
newsitem.headline: Croatian money market trade brisk on good supply.

text.p: The Croatian money market saw brisk morning trade on Wednesday with a continuing abundance of kuna funds on offer, dealers said.
They estimated the trade, totalling 38.1 million kuna at steady rates, was completed by mid-morning.
Fresh demand for 29 million kuna was met in full, and 9.1 million was rolled over. Supply stood at 70 million kuna.
Tuesday's overnight trade totalled 45 million kuna bought by three banks to maintain their mandatory reserves. -- Laura Lui, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
